title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vega Ioane (shoulder) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Vega Ioane is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ioane left Monday's game early against the Chargers and did not return. His presence in practice to begin the practice week is a good sign.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adam Randall (neck/hamstring) activated from IR
items.desc: The Ravens activated Adam Randall from injured reserve.
items.impact: Randall will add depth in the backfield for Baltimore. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Upton Stout (shoulder/neck) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Upton Stout was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stout continues to manage both shoulder and neck injuries.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Renardo Green (back) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Renardo Green was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Green was originally reported to be sidelined from practice on Wednesday. He was able to get in some reps in a limited fashion.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Thompson (hamstring) designated to return from IR
items.desc: The Cowboys designated Jalen Thompson to return from injured reserve.
items.impact: Thompson will have 21 days to officially be activated by Dallas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Lohner has practice window opened by Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos are opening the 21-day return-to-play window for TE Caleb Lohner.
items.impact: Lohner missed all of camp and has not practiced since Denver's rookie minicamp in May. He'll add depth in the tight end room for the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody Barton (concussion) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Cody Barton is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Barton remains in concussion protocol. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 11.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Carnell Tate is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a good sign for Tate who last played in Week 7. He remains hopeful to return in Week 11 for the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Evans is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Evans was hopeful to return to practice this week. He'll need to be monitored the rest of the week as he continues to work his way back from an Achilles injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (neck) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Greenlaw is battling a neck injury. 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said he might practice later in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) could play in Week 11
items.desc: Sauce Gardner has a chance to play on Thursday against the Texans.
items.impact: The Colts ruled out five players for Thursday and Gardner was not one of them. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charvarius Ward Sr. (knee) ruled out for Week 11
items.desc: Charvarius Ward Sr. has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Ward will be sidelined on a short week after suffering a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Travis (knee) ruled out for Week 11
items.desc: Jalen Travis has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Travis was unable to practice all week due to a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jerry Tillery (calf) ruled out for Week 11
items.desc: Jerry Tillery has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Tillery was unable to practice all week for the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bernhard Raimann (concussion) ruled out for Week 11
items.desc: Bernhard Raimann has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Raimann will be sidelined on a short week as expected after being placed in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Mallory (hamstring) ruled out for Week 11
items.desc: Will Mallory has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Mallory was unable to practice on Tuesday. He'll be sidelined on a short week for the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Chris Bell is considered "day-to-day."
items.impact: Bell did not play last week for Miami as he manages soreness in his surgically repaired knee. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Smith (concussion) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Trey Smith is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith landed in the concussion protocol. He is trending towards sitting in Week 11 for the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylon Moore (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylon Moore is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore was ruled out this past week by the Chiefs. He'll need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was reported to begin the week that Walker could sit another game on Sunday. It continues to trend in that direction with Walker missing practice to begin the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk passes 49ers physical
items.desc: Brandon Aiyuk has reportedly passed the 49ers' physical.
items.impact: "He's 100% healthy right now, in shape, and working out full force," Drew Rosenhaus, Aiyuk's agent, told Dianna Russini. He'll look to sign with another team when the 49ers release him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Onyemata (groin) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Jets opened the practice window of DT David Onyemata.
items.impact: Onyemata has been on IR for eight weeks. He'll have the next 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Yaya Diaby (knee) practices Wednesday
items.desc: Yaya Diaby was practicing with a brace on his knee on Wednesday.
items.impact: Diaby is continuing to manage a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mayfield entered the week dealing with a foot strain. His status remains up in the air heading into Week 11.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Milton III to remain Eagles starter in Week 11
items.desc: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni announced Joe Milton will start in Week 11 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Milton started in the Eagles' loss to the Giants before their bye. He'll continue to add more mobility as a rusher to go along with an inconsistent arm.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) to miss rest of season
items.desc: Titans WR Wan'Dale Robinson is out for the season after being placed on injured reserve.
items.impact: Robinson caught just 32 receptions for 272 yards and three touchdowns over nine games. Carnell Tate, Eric Ayomanor and Chimere Dike will lead the Titans wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) could return in Week 11
items.desc: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said he feels "pretty good" about Dontayvion Wicks returning for Week 11 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Sirianni made the same comment about DeVonta Smith, both who have been sidelined for the past several weeks. They will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) could return in Week 11
items.desc: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said he feels "pretty good" about DeVonta Smith returning for Week 11 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Smith hasn't played since Week 6 because of the hamstring issue. He'll need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Geno Smith (ankle) limited on Wednesday
items.desc: Geno Smith (ankle) gets in limited action at Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Smith is dealing with an ankle injury that took him out of this past Sunday's game early. The issue is not severe, however, and the veteran QB was at least able to get in some activity Wednesday. Rookie Cade Klubnik would be in line to start if Smith ultimately cannot go in Week 11.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) sits out Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Cooper was questionable all last week, but ultimately gave it a shot Sunday. He wasn't around long, however, exiting after being on the field for just one snap. Cooper's absence on Wednesday doesn't provide much encouragement for his Week 11 status.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Isaiah Williams (ribs) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Isaiah Williams (ribs) did not take part in Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: Williams took a big hit in Sunday's game and briefly exited. The wide receiver is dealing with some sore ribs and sitting out Wednesday's practice.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Harrison Phillips (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Harrison Phillips (ankle) did not take part in Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: Phillips has been playing through injury lately, but he did take Wednesday off, which is at least of some note. The veteran defensive lineman played in over 50% of the snaps in Week 10.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Robert Hainsey (knee) out for Week 11
items.desc: Robert Hainsey (knee) will not play against the Giants in Week 11.
items.impact: Hainsey exited this past Sunday's win over the Titans due to a knee sprain and is considered week-to-week. Jonah Monheim will start at center for the Jaguars.

items.title: Albert Reese released by Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals released OL Albert Reese.
items.impact: Reese will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.title: Jared Harrison-Hunte signs with Cardinals active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals signed DL Jared Harrison-Hunte to their active roster.
items.impact: Harrison-Hunte will add depth on the defensive line for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Wydett Williams Jr. signs with Cardinals active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals signed S Wydett Williams Jr. to their active roster.
items.impact: Williams will add depth in the secondary for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Burch (MCL) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed LB Jordan Burch on injured reserve.
items.impact: Burch is out for the season with the MCL injury he suffered.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Wingard (hand/wrist) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cardinals placed DB Andrew Wingard on injured reserve.
items.impact: Wingard will miss at least the next four games for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joshua Simon signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers signed Joshua Simon to their practice squad.
items.impact: Simon will add depth at tight end for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eric Gray released by Giants
items.desc: The Giants released RB Eric Gray.
items.impact: Gray will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.desc: The Jets released Nathan Voorhis.
items.impact: Voorhis will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.desc: The Dolphins signed DL Chris Smith to their practice squad.
items.impact: Smith will add depth on the defensive line for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.desc: The Dolphins signed DL Matthew Butler to their practice squad.
items.impact: Butler will add depth on the defensive line for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brady Boyd signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed WR Brady Boyd to their practice squad.
items.impact: Boyd will add depth in the wide receiver room for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.desc: The Dolphins signed DL Eric Watts to their active roster.
items.impact: Watts will add depth on the edge for Miami.

items.desc: The Dolphins signed DL Jordan Jefferson to their active roster.
items.impact: Jefferson will add depth on the defensive line for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.desc: The Dolphins signed QB Brady Cook to their active roster.
items.impact: Cook will continue to backup Kyle McCord behind center.

items.desc: The Dolphins placed DL Jordan Phillips on injured reserve.
items.impact: Phillips is out for the season with torn biceps.
